data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.9m (2021: favourable development of GBP 6.1m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 3.7m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.0m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 1.1m in Other direct.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 661.021m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (gross) of approximately GBP 32.6m (strengthening, ~4.9% of opening reserves) across underwriting years up to 2020. This gross deterioration contrasts with a reported net favourable prior-year development of GBP 3.9m (net of reinsurance), driven by releases in Third Party Liability and Aviation that were more than offset on a gross basis by adverse development in other direct lines and largely mitigated by reinsurance recoveries. Line-specific net movements disclosed were releases of GBP 3.7m (direct Third Party Liability) and GBP 1.0m (Aviation), partially offset by a GBP 1.1m strengthening in Other direct.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was not provided explicitly in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note (that note reports NET of reinsurance GBP 3.9m). A gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (see _claims_triangle). The triangle values are presented in the report in GBP '000; the gross PYD above is calculated from that triangle and converted to millions. 'Other direct' mapping to 'Marine' is an inference (document uses 'Other direct'); confidence for that mapping is lower. No specific named loss events affecting prior years were stated in the movement note.
